trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 3760162. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/3760162 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so the zbMATH REST API was used only as resolver metadata.

zbMATH API identified the exact work as title 'A COLLECTION OF OPEN PROBLEMS', DOI 10.1111/j.1749-6632.1979.tb32837.x, authors/editors M. Capobianco, S. Maurer, D. McCarthy, and J. Molluzzo, source Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences 319(1), pages 565-592, 1979.

Crossref confirmed the same DOI and supplied Wiley landing and PDF URLs. The Wiley PDF endpoint returned 403/Cloudflare challenge from local fetch. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status='closed', best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Exact-work searches for the DOI and title found Zendy metadata marked unavailable in region and citation/reference snippets in other works, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

No accepted questions were extracted because the only recovered material was resolver/API metadata, paywalled or challenged publisher pages, and third-party citation snippets. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting problem statements from those materials.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/3760162.json and outputs/latest.json.
